author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new BMW M3 CS Handschalter. It’s a limited-edition final hurrah for the sixth-generation M3, and combines the lightweight and track-focused chassis of the M3 CS, with rear-wheel drive and a manual gearbox. Apart from the silly name, it sounds like the perfect M3 – or is it an overpriced swansong? 

🚗 BMW M3 CS Handschalter
🎤 Jethro Bovingdon
